user.title: EverLights app
user.description: The address of the everlights app (not the bridge), e.g. http://192.168.1.20:8080. Leave the token empty for the home port; for the remote (tunnel) address, paste the Shortcut token from the app's Health tab.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the app at that address.
error.invalid_auth: The app asked for a token. Check the Shortcut token, or use the home port.
error.not_everlights: Something answered, but it isn't the everlights app.

abort.already_configured: This bridge is already set up.
